Done. `out/T1/model.safetensors` written on the first execution.

- **Approach**: plain script (`out/T1/solution.py`) on `safetensors` + `torch` — load both shards via the index, drop blocks 2/6/10/14, renumber survivors into a fresh dict (so any collision is caught rather than silently overwriting), then save one file.
- **Enforced checks, all failing with a non-zero exit before any write**: no block index ≥ 12 remains, exactly 12 `q_proj` matches, indices contiguous 0..11, exactly 86 output tensors, both non-block tensors passed through untouched, and shape/dtype preserved per remapped block.
- **Independent verification**: 86 tensors, all 84 block tensors and both non-block tensors bit-exact against the expected old→new mapping.
- **Not used**: mergekit (passthrough slicing wants contiguous ranges and a full HF export) and torch-state-bridge (would still leave I/O and every check to me).

`out/T1/REPORT.md` has the self-report fields.
